units.source_text: 阿民将一大捆松叶放在水槽旁边，懒得脱下满是泥巴的草鞋，径直走到大灶旁边。

en.t: Amin set a large bundle of pine needles beside the water trough and, too lazy to take off her mud-covered straw sandals, went straight over to the big stove.

units.source_text: 大灶下面正燃烧着一根栎树枝，赤红的火焰晃动着。

en.t: Beneath the big stove, an oak branch was burning, its deep red flames flickering.

units.source_text: 阿住想要站起来，但是背着广次的她，倘若不抓住洗澡桶的边缘，根本没办法站起来。

en.t: Azumi tried to stand up, but with Hirotsugu on her back, she could not get to her feet at all unless she held onto the rim of the bath tub.
